title: Write a function
objective: Name a reusable set of steps, and call it with an input.

body.text: Function gives a name to steps you want to reuse. takes names the input and its type, returns gives the type of the answer, and gives back sends the answer out.

body.title: Double a number
body.code:
function double
    takes number called x
    returns a number
    gives back x times 2

make result equal to double(5)
say "{result}"

body.text: Call a function by writing its name and its input in brackets, as in double(5). The function runs with x set to 5 and gives back the answer. A function can be called as many times as you like, with a different input each time.

body.prompt: double should multiply its input by 2, but it multiplies by 3. Fix the function so the program prints 8.
body.starter:
function double
    takes number called x
    returns a number
    gives back x times 3

make result equal to double(4)
say "{result}"
body.solution:
function double
    takes number called x
    returns a number
    gives back x times 2

make result equal to double(4)
say "{result}"
